generalization.overfittingAssessment: Moderate generalization gap. No catastrophic overfitting observed.

dataLeakageAudit.finding: In the raw dataset, modal_price equals (min_price + max_price)/2 in 94.26% of records (7,533/7,992) and lies within [min_price, max_price] in 100% of records. Both min_price and max_price were strictly excluded from model features to prevent mathematical target leakage.

limitations: Single-day snapshot: The training dataset contains records exclusively for 2026-09-20. The model CANNOT perform temporal, 7-day, 30-day, or future seasonal price forecasting.
Not a crop recommendation engine: Mandi prices alone do not capture soil chemistry (pH, NPK), climate (rainfall, temperature), or yield outcomes.
Error magnitude: Test MAE of ₹1,121.78/quintal means predictions have non-trivial error bands for low-value commodities.
Categorical domain limitation: Novel varieties or unobserved markets will default to target-encoded global priors.
labelingRequirement: Market price estimation / analysis model (NOT future price forecasting model)
